page.overview:
What is White Orchard?

White Orchard is a region and village located in Temeria famous for its fruit orchards, whose boughs burst out white blossoms come spring. The Ismena river flows through the village and continues north.

After the Battle of White Orchard, the village lost its independence and was annexed by Nilfgaard.

There is a Nilfgaardian Garrison headquartered in the northwest point of the region near the mouth of the river that, in , was controlled by Captain Peter Saar Gwynleve. In addition to the merchants listed below there are also six Places of Power. Two are for Quen and one for each of the other four signs.
